name: Edison State Community College
tuition_note: In-state (Ohio resident) tuition & fees for 2026-27 from edisonohio.edu/tuition. Charged per credit hour at $206.62 total (instructional $180.32 + general $14.30 + technology $5.00 + activity $1.00 + career service $6.00). Annual figure = full-time 15 credit-hours/semester rate ($3,099.30) x 2 semesters = $6,198.60. Housing null: Edison State is a commuter community college with no on-campus housing; no room cost published.
